description: This source file defines extension methods for the IRelationalStorage interface, providing functionalities such as executing multiple inserts, reading data asynchronously with reflection, executing commands, and obtaining streams from data readers. It facilitates database operations with support for parameterized queries and reflection-based result mapping.

classes.name: RelationalStorageExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for working with IRelationalStorage, including batch inserts, data retrieval, command execution, and stream access.

methods.name: ExecuteMultipleInsertIntoAsync
methods.description: Performs a batch insert into a specified table using a parameterized or inline SQL approach, supporting property name mapping and single-time column value generation.

methods.name: ReadAsync<TResult> (overload with selector and parameterProvider)
methods.description: Executes a query and maps the result set to a collection of TResult using reflection, with custom parameter provider.

methods.name: ReadAsync<TResult> (with object parameters)
methods.description: Executes a query with parameters provided as an object, returning a collection of TResult mapped via reflection.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync (with parameters)
methods.description: Executes a non-query command with parameters, supporting cancellation.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync (without parameters)
methods.description: Executes a non-query command without parameters, supporting cancellation.

methods.name: GetStream
methods.description: Returns a stream for a data column, using native support if available or a chunked read otherwise.
